امتدحا (form VIII)

# اُمْتُدِحَا (umtudiḥā) /um.tu.di.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# اِمْتَدِحَا (imtadiḥā) /im.ta.di.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
